authorizationGates.summary: 允许定义可表达具体海域、节点、编成、装备与条件的版本化 R7 schema。
requiredEvidence: schema rejects unknown fields and unsupported versions
concrete fields require versioned evidence references
R6 authoring remains unable to contain concrete route fields

authorizationGates.summary: 允许在独立审查后写入选定 pilot family 的具体攻略内容。
requiredEvidence: each route binds exact lineage revision and semantic digest
hard mechanics have two independent readable evidence groups
unknown, conflict and expiry produce a non-empty fallback

authorizationGates.summary: 允许 renderer 在用户明确展开后显示已审查的具体路线。
requiredEvidence: feature remains opt-in and existing quest guide remains fallback
no main or preload dependency is added to the route evaluator
privacy and horizontal overflow checks pass with synthetic fixtures

authorizationGates.summary: 允许按脱敏步骤执行实账号只读显示验收。
requiredEvidence: owner starts the game manually and credentials are not handled by the agent
no game action or communication mutation occurs
page, filter, panel and window state are restored

authorizationGates.summary: 允许把已审查路线加入可分发 runtime bundle。
requiredEvidence: schema, pilot content, renderer and acceptance gates are approved
signed bundle and rollback path are independently verified
expired or withdrawn content cannot remain runtime eligible

authorizationGates.summary: 允许另行决定是否默认启用具体路线显示。
requiredEvidence: fallback remains reachable when route knowledge is missing
default change is reviewed as a separate release decision

candidates.reason: 完整任务前置链仍依赖维护后的 curated relation。
剩余演习机会不可从现有只读状态完整观测。
解锁、历史成功与受注任务可观测，当前舰队条件和资源方针可保持人工 gate。
可用匿名舰队与装备类别事实，适合作为目标规则和具体路线证据门禁的首个战斗型 pilot。
需要先固定目标、route variant 与版本化制空和索敌公式。
EO 路线与可负担性资料的复查周期更短，应在 pilot 门禁稳定后接入。
